chapter.verse: Topa phat un, lungsim thutangte a omna, mihon kikhopna sungah ka lungsim khempeuh tawh Topa tungah lungdamna ka ko ding hi.
Topa ’ nasepnate lian a, hoih a sa mi khempeuh in tuate kankan uh hi.
Ama nasepna in pahtawina leh minliatna tawh kidim a, ama thumanna in kip tawntung hi.
Amah in phawk tawntung dingin a lamdang ama sepnate hong bawl a, Topa dikin hehpihna a nei hi.
Amah in amah zahtakte an pia a, ama thuciamna hong phawk tawntung hi.
Amah in ama mite tungah minamte’ gamh a piakna tawh ama vangliatna hong lak khin hi.
Ama nasepnate khempeuh ah amah thumanin citak a, ama thupiaknate muan’taak mahmah hi.
A tawntungin tuate kip ngitnget a, thuman leh thutang tawh zuih ding ahi hi.
Amah in a mite hong honkhia a, amah in a tawntunga dingin thupiakna a bawl khin hi. Ama min, siangtho-in kihtak-huai mahmah hi!
Topa zahtakna in pilna kipatna ahi hi; ama thupiak a zuite khempeuh tungah thukhen siamna a pia hi. Amah phat tawntung ding ahi hi.
